Along with Maldraxxian Bonemages, Maldraxxian Skeletons, Maldraxxian Necromancers, Maldraxxian Boneguards and Maldraxxian Champions he would help the Maw Walker reach the sixth floor. Together with the Maw Walker they would take the fight to Custodian Thonar, but ultimately all but the Maw Walker would perish.

LOL is an acronym for "Laugh Out Loud". In lower-case it is "lol". * Frequently used in place of typing out a laugh ("ha ha ha"). * Very frequently to show that you're being playful, not serious, or are kidding, quite like saying doch in German. * Upper-case and lower-case typically have slightly different meanings. "lol" is typically a light laugh or chuckle, while "LOL" is a heartier, louder laugh. * When you type only "LOL" or "lol" in-game, your character will automatically do the /laugh animation & sound. See also Emote. While LOL literally merely means "laugh out loud", it is much more widely use than as an in-game expression of amusement. It is applied as widely as real laughter is, t
__NOTOC__ Lady Sathrah is a tarantula found near Wellspring Lake in the northeastern parts of Teldrassil.
Lady Anacondra (formerly known as Scarletleaf) is one of the Fanglords of the Druids of the Fang and the first boss of the Wailing Caverns.
Lady Palanseer was a Forsaken PvP Jewelcrafting designs vendor located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.

__NOTOC__ Lady Illucia Barov is a ghost mini-boss found in Scholomance. She was the wife of Lord Alexei Barov and formerly one of the six mini-bosses who had be killed in order to summon Darkmaster Gandling.
The acronym L2P, or L2, stands for "Learn to (play)". It is normally said to someone who obviously does not know how to play their class. Example: :"OMG, you aggroed the entire room nub, l2p."

LD is short for link disconnect or link dead. It is usually used when someone goes offline in a party, where everyone just sits around, until that party member returns. In some heavy role-playing guilds, the members may refer to this event as if it were a god or goddess "Eldee", and this deity had taken the particular character away for a time.

Lady Blaumeux is one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas. Lady Blaumeux is a master of the shadow, able to drain the essence of life from those she encounters. It is presumed that Lady Blaumeux was formally a paladin. She wrote This is my Runeblade... Blaumeux likely represents the "Rider of Famine", based on her black color scheme.

Lady Falther'ess is a level 40 elite Scourge banshee found in Razorfen Downs during the Scourge Invasion. She initially appears as a friendly imprisoned female human, but she can be tracked as a friendly undead. Once she is released from her prison she transforms into her banshee form and becomes aggressive.
Kzixx is a goblin rare goods vendor located by the road near the eastern end of the Darkened Bank in Duskwood. He is guarded by Watcher Callahan of the Night Watch.
__NOTOC__ Lady Sevine is a demon warlock found at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Although once an orc, Sevine is now in fact a demon.
Lady Hederine was a level 61 elite rare mob succubus found in the Darkwhisper Gorge of Winterspring.

Lady is a level 5 critter, chasing Cleo around the Blacksmith in Arathi Basin. Lady and Cleo appear only when the Alliance claims the Blacksmith for the League of Arathor. The Horde counterpart of Lady is Underfoot who chases Spike around when the Defilers control the Blacksmith.

Lady Mara Fordragon was the High Clerist of the Kingdom of Stormwind during the period of the First War. After the orcs decimated much of the kingdom, Mara Fordragon became the patron of the refugees of the war who chose to flee to the northern lands of Lordaeron, which had thus far been untouched by the fighting. A statue of Lady Fordragon stood in the Royal Gallery of Stormwind Keep, while another is present in the Sanctum of Light among statues of paladins.
__NOTOC__ Kyrenna is a blood elf cheese vendor located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. She appears to be unhappy about her occupation.

The Laboratory is located deep within Scholomance. It is accessed from the Viewing Room via the southern doorway. The laboratory itself is a dead end, but it is the location of one of the game's very few Alchemy Labs. Besides a few necromancers, it also contains the lich Ras Frostwhisper, and potentially the fierce Kormok for the Dungeon Set 2 questline.

Lachlan MacGraff is a Wildhammer dwarf quest giver in Kirthaven in the Twilight Highlands. He is the Grand Shaman of the Wildhammer dwarves.

Lady Humps is a camel in the caravan with Adarrah and Budd Nedreck. She is located in Thistleshrub Valley, Tanaris. Once you accept the quest Easy Money, you try to ride her. This triggers the cut-scene to which the caravan proceeds into Uldum. You see her again standing next to Harrison Jones when you turn in the quest Take it to 'Em!. Although, it's not absolute, it appears she gets killed in the explosion during Exploding Through.

.]] Lady Calindris (formerly known as Relic Keeper Calindris) is a high-ranking eredar priestess of the Burning Legion who wields the corrupted draenei staff known as :T'uure, Beacon of the Naaru. __NOTOC__ Lady Keletress is a commander of the Burning Legion. Keletress was present at the Battle for the Broken Shore. She is cruel and enjoys sowing chaos. Thus, she has made it her personal mission to wipe out the monks of Azeroth, seeing their quest for balance and order as an affront to the Legion. She also has large green wings, which is unusual for an eredar. Keletress lead the first invasion against the monks at the Peak of Serenity, ending with its destruction. She then lead the second invasion, this time on Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest with her lieutenant, Skola Greatsword and captured a group of tian monk students which were later rescued at the Gates of Valor in Stormheim.

The steadfast kyrian (sometimes pluralized as kyrians) of Bastion are one of the Covenants in the Shadowlands. They are a race of angelic beings that serve as soul guides whose discipline and duty compels them to safeguard souls from the mortal realm as they pass into the Shadowlands. They are messengers, couriers, and some of the purest souls in the realm of death. They are the forebears of the Val'kyr, the spirit healers, and more.

The steadfast kyrian of Bastion are one of the Covenants in the Shadowlands. Their discipline and duty compels them to safeguard souls from the mortal realm as they pass into the Shadowlands. They are messengers, couriers, and some of the purest souls in the Shadowlands. The Kyrian souls move on to become noble beings such as Spirit Healers, whose true title are Kyrian Watchers. Souls that are sent into Bastion are souls that have gone through harsh burdens in life and seek the Kyrian to regain their virtue.
__NOTOC__ Kyrian Aspirants are kyrian located in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion. They also appear in the Ring of Fates in Oribos during Prisoner of Interest.

Kyrestia the Firstborne, the Archon, is the first of the winged kyrians, the most stalwart and dedicated of the Eternal Ones, and the ruler of Bastion and the Kyrian Covenant. She resides at Archon's Rise in Elysian Hold. Kyrestia is wholeheartedly dedicated to the laws of Bastion and is very resistant to change, reacting to evidence that the Path of Ascension may be flawed with indignant anger. At the start of the Bastion storyline, the Archon and her servants are slow to acknowledge the true threat of the Forsworn and the Jailer. When her former champion Devos personally leads the Forsworn on an attack on the Spires of Ascension, Kyrestia finally begins to consider change in Bastion. Durin
Kyrian Scholars are kyrian located at Haetio's Solace in Bastion.
The Kyrian Mender is an Ascended kyrian located at Haetio's Solace in Bastion. She can be found healing a Kyrian Scholar.

Lady Ouix'Ara is a lich of the House of Rituals who oversees Death's End in Revendreth from a platform in the southeastern part of the camp. She is a servant of Kel'Thuzad and the hand of Margrave Sin'dane in Revendreth, and hopes to ascend to the rank of baroness. Ouix'Ara has entered an agreement with the Tithelord, in which he supplies her with anima that she sends to Kel'Thuzad's allies in Maldraxxus, while she in turn provides the Tithelord and his venthyr allies with Maldraxxian weapons.

Lady Rodica is a venthyr located in the Sinfang Parlor in Revendreth.

Lady Oana is a venthyr located outside the Primrose Residence in the Redelav District in Revendreth. She can be found absolving an Abject Soul of its past sins, occasionally spawning various memories.
Lady Lerae is a venthyr located in the Duskmire Domain in Revendreth.
Lady Daniela is a venthyr located at the Briarbane Stables in Revendreth. She can be found talking with Lord Silviu.
